title: Simulate, Reason, Decide: Scientific Reasoning with LLMs for Simulation-Driven Decision Making (MechSim)
problem: Agents reasoning about scientific simulator mechanisms for decisions
task: Policy selection; simulator selection; mechanism explanation
evaluation_protocol: P@k/R@k vs oracle simulator; regret; LLM judge 1-5 on 4 dimensions (5 rounds)
uses_execution_or_simulation: Yes: simulators run; sensitivity analysis on parameters/assumptions; per-claim verification is an LLM prompt
uses_llm_judges: Yes: judge prompt names methods (A Causal-Copilot ... D MechSim): not blinded; verifier is an LLM
benchmark_construction: Oracle simulators; 100 sampled scenarios; no human-authored questions
exact_overlap: Mechanism-grounded explanations + a verification stage; simulator as evidence
exact_non_overlap: No claim-level verifier accuracy; no human labels; explanation quality only by unblinded LLM judge; no coverage; not OS/education

title: Towards Faithful Agentic XAI (FAX)
problem: Agentic XAI explanations can be fluent but unfaithful
domain: Explaining RL policies (Crafter) and tabular classifiers
task: Decompose explanation into claims; test with state editing/counterfactuals; filter
representation: Atomic claims about model behaviour; statuses corroborated/refuted/inconclusive
evaluation_protocol: Simulation faithfulness via LLM evaluator predicting target model on unseen states; 40 scenarios; 3 seeds
uses_execution_or_simulation: Yes: re-executes target model under interventions
uses_llm_judges: Yes: LLM simulator for faithfulness; G-Eval usability
exact_non_overlap: Verifier verdicts never checked against independent labels; no per-error-type recall; ground truth is an ML model not a world mechanism; 'verified' is local (own caveat)

title: Falsification-Based Verification of LLM-Generated Optimization Models
problem: Certifying LLM-written LP/MILP models without reference labels
task: Duality/sensitivity test battery vs threshold tester vs LLM judges
evaluation_protocol: Recall/FPR per error class on 6947 mutants; McNemar; Wilson CIs; blind-set theory
uses_execution_or_simulation: Yes: HiGHS solver calls are the verifier
uses_human_annotation: Only adjudication of 155 flagged cases (no agreement reported)
uses_llm_judges: Yes: as baselines (Qwen 7B; R1-distill; DeepSeek V4)
exact_overlap: Near-identical measurement design: deterministic checker vs LLM judges; per-class recall/FPR; characterized blind set; value-correct-but-wrong cases; 76.8% of flags were extraction noise
exact_non_overlap: Formal models not prose; labels by construction not expert claim labels; no NLI/RAGAS; not OS/education

title: VeriFin: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Verifying LLM-Generated Financial Claims

representation: Verification plan (metric; formula; operands; units; periods) + XBRL facts
evaluation_protocol: False accepts/rejects; abstention; coverage; 600 + 67 claims; 6 generator models; repair recovery
